statement: MAE monitor appears descriptively better in 2/3 seeds but no independent generalization or significance claim is supported.
hypothesis: Raw-scale MAE early stopping may better align selection with external MAE.
counterevidence: Seed46 favors MSE; only three seeds and the same reused 91-row validation set; seed46 MSE resumed checkpoint and runtime/cache paths differ.
impact: Do not replace MSE globally; preserve monitor as Caco2-only candidate.
proposed_resolution: If separately authorized, confirm on matched fresh seeds and fixed split with identical cached representation path and checkpoint policy.
verification_criterion: Paired deltas across preregistered seeds plus full execution identity; no p-value from three seeds.

statement: The new Caco2 branch proves caching and checkpoint resume only for Caco2; the other 21 task interfaces remain unverified.
hypothesis: A zero-fit preparation stage can validate task-specific input/output, target transforms and scoring before training.
counterevidence: Historical Mini22 implementation and task metrics provide reusable evidence, but not proof of current runner support.
impact: All non-Caco2 training proposals remain blocked_assets until task fixtures pass.
proposed_resolution: Prepare one-task fixtures and validate train-only fit transforms, frozen encoder checks, prediction scale and template row mapping.
verification_criterion: Per-task fixture passes with exact task/split/row_index mapping and immutable encoder/buffer hashes.

statement: Task-level history shows extreme sample-size and class-balance differences; solubility valid skeleton anomaly is flagged in historical review.
hypothesis: Adaptive task selection improves information per unit compute compared with uniform shallow tuning.
counterevidence: Selection may bias toward easy/large tasks and historical splits may not match current task source state.
impact: Do not launch broad screen before raw per-task manifest/profile audit.
proposed_resolution: Audit raw train/valid/test row counts, missingness, label classes, SMILES/scaffold groups and target distributions without modifying rows.
verification_criterion: Signed per-task profile table; no cleaning/deduplication/relabelling; all row IDs reconciled.

statement: Validation has been reused across historical comparisons; a new Chat session does not reset adaptive overfitting.
hypothesis: Predeclared screen/confirm stages and task-level aggregate feedback reduce opportunistic selection.
counterevidence: Official rules permit valid tuning, so strict one-look policy is recommendation rather than hard rule.
impact: Treat improvements as selection-stage evidence, not final generalization.
proposed_resolution: Record every valid use, predeclare candidate and decision rules, keep row-level truth/residual private.
verification_criterion: Evaluation-use ledger updated and every score linked to run/task/split/metric/receipt.

statement: GPU0 sharing failure remains a failure; GPU1 acceptance is limited to the observed idle-resident serial small-head branch.
hypothesis: A narrow GPU1 low-load serial branch may be operationally viable under fresh prechecks.
counterevidence: No direct resident workload latency/throughput proof; one historical observation missing; no universal concurrent safety evidence.
impact: Never generalize to arbitrary shared GPU or erase GPU0 failed attempts.
proposed_resolution: Require fresh health, ownership and resource checks; abort on observed contention; report all failed attempts separately.
verification_criterion: Per-run resource observations and explicit branch scope; no claim of zero impact without direct measurement.

statement: The required 23 original-source reading contract was not completed in this session.
hypothesis: Remaining sources can be read through exact registered URIs in a subsequent audit pass.
counterevidence: No evidence that unread sources are inaccessible; current limitation is not attempted or not completed reading.
impact: Scientific status remains needs_evidence; Q2/Q3 and row-identity claims are bounded.
proposed_resolution: Read each remaining R-entry at its exact URI, capture commit/SHA, line count and observed facts.
verification_criterion: 23/23 entry_ids with original read evidence and all Q0-Q7 dependencies cross-referenced.
